learning_outcomes.text: Explain where AI and data can add value across the construction lifecycle
Describe common applications: estimating, scheduling, safety, quality and design support
Relate AI needs to data quality, BIM data and site data capture
Identify risks: reliability, bias, safety-critical decisions and accountability
Apply a simple evaluation to decide whether an AI tool is fit for a task
Keep humans accountable for decisions and communicate AI limitations honestly

integrative_case: A contractor is piloting AI across a project: identify where estimating, scheduling, safety monitoring and quality checks could benefit, assess whether the available BIM and site data support it, evaluate one tool honestly against real outcomes, and keep a named human accountable for every safety- or cost-critical decision.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
